functionDeclarations.name: get_nominal_code_mapping
functionDeclarations.description: The current mapping: one key per accounting role (sales_orders, cogs, inventory_control, ...), each holding a nominal code id as a string, or null when unmapped. (GET /api/v2/settings/nominal-code-mapping)

functionDeclarations.name: list_nominal_codes
functionDeclarations.description: The chart of accounts as SKU.io holds it: { id, code, name, type, archived_at } per nominal code, mirrored from QuickBooks Online or Xero when connected. Archived codes are excluded unless filter[archived]=all. (GET /api/v2/nominal-codes)

per_page.description: Page size (default 10). Iterate page until last_page.

sort.description: id, name, code or type (prefix - for descending). Default -id.

functionDeclarations.name: lookup_nominal_codes
functionDeclarations.description: Fallback when the token has no accounting:read — every nominal code as { id, name, code } only (no type), ordered by code. Needs settings:read and the sales_channels.show permission. (GET /api/sub-sales-channels/lookup/nominal-codes)

functionDeclarations.name: update_nominal_code_mapping
functionDeclarations.description: Save mapping keys. Only the keys in the body are written; send nothing but the approved keys. Values are nominal code ids (from list-nominal-codes); an id with no account behind it is refused with 422, per key. Returns the whole mapping. Needs the settings.update permission. (PUT /api/v2/settings/nominal-code-mapping)

sales_orders.description: Nominal code id for sales income.

shipping_sales_orders.description: Nominal code id for shipping charged to customers.

cogs.description: Nominal code id for cost of goods sold.

inventory_control.description: Nominal code id for the inventory asset (a current asset).

accrued_purchases.description: Nominal code id for purchase clearing (accrued / prepaid purchases).

accounts_receivable.description: Nominal code id for accounts receivable.

accounts_payable.description: Nominal code id for accounts payable.

sales_tax.description: Nominal code id for the sales tax liability.
